title: Variable and residual scaling for local root capture
objective: Measure variable and residual scaling independently of start selection and choose a robust fixed-start local policy without accepting positive-residual stationary points.
hypothesis: Bounds-based variable normalization plus truth-independent residual scaling improves local capture and evaluation cost on scale-spread and ill-conditioned systems when the linearized step uses rank-aware QR.

included: bounded smooth square and overdetermined systems
analytic, ForwardDiff and central finite-difference Jacobians
dense column-pivoted QR and graph-derived sparse QR

literature.claim: Official NonlinearSolve guidance exposes LM, Gauss-Newton and trust-region methods for nonlinear least squares.
literature.assumptions: The residual model is smooth enough and derivative information is meaningful.
literature.break_conditions: A solver may stop at a nonzero least-squares stationary point.

literature.claim: Official LinearSolve guidance recommends QR or SVD for precision and provides rank-revealing sparse column-pivoted QR.
literature.assumptions: The selected factorization supports the matrix structure and numeric type.
literature.break_conditions: Severe rank defect, changing sparsity or unsupported arbitrary precision.

literature.claim: ForwardDiff implements performant forward-mode automatic differentiation for native type-generic Julia code.
literature.assumptions: Executed primitive paths accept dual numbers and are differentiable locally.
literature.break_conditions: Opaque foreign callbacks, hard Float64 assertions or nonsmooth branches.

literature.claim: LM robustness and speed trade off in narrow and flat nonlinear least-squares landscapes.
literature.assumptions: Smooth least-squares model with informative local derivatives.
literature.break_conditions: Invalid domains, guards and piecewise branch transitions.

controls.description: Raw variables and raw residuals with the same LM-QR algorithm and fixed starts.
Analytic Jacobian for generated families, used to isolate scaling from derivative error.

candidates.description: Normalize variables from finite bounds while leaving residuals raw.
Scale each residual from declared metadata or an independent calibration block.
Combine bounds-based variable normalization and residual scaling.
Apply the winning scale policy with prepared ForwardDiff or sparse colored ForwardDiff.

synthetic_families.purpose: Isolate row-scale spread with an analytically known root and Jacobian.
Measure scaling in narrow curved Rosenbrock-like root valleys.
Exercise QR rank diagnostics without claiming singular-root support.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Constructed SVD factors and analytic root

synthetic_families.purpose: Separate true roots from positive-residual or rank-deficient least-squares endpoints.
Stress conditioning as a geometry intersection approaches tangency.
Check whether scaling changes capture among several known basins.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Invertible analytic warp of known roots
counterexample_for: scale policy that favors one basin

real_problem_policy: Use only independently audited Gold development problems; execute every variant from the same saved starts and never infer scale from a known answer.

execution_order: Run a 2x2 raw, variable, residual and combined scaling factorial with analytic Jacobians
Compare analytic, prepared ForwardDiff, central finite difference and sparse colored ForwardDiff
Run the frozen candidate once on family-disjoint locked instances
design.pairing: Every variant receives the identical problem instance, 32 saved starts, local iteration budget and canonical endpoint gate.
design.freeze_rule: Scale formula and derivative routing freeze before locked validation; the locked result is not used to retune.
design.locked_validation_rule: Opening a locked family for diagnosis burns it and requires replacement by a generator-disjoint family.
notes: Primary roots are at least 0.05 normalized units from artificial bounds.
Strict-boundary and exactly singular cases are diagnostics and cannot promote this policy.

local_maxiters.rationale: Bounds local work while allowing difficult fixed-start traces to expose stagnation.
local_maxiters.freeze_rule: Keep fixed across all scaling variants.

solver_tolerance_exponent.rationale: Matches the documented type-dependent NonlinearSolve default eps(T)^(4/5).
solver_tolerance_exponent.freeze_rule: No tuning from target recall; change only through numerical-error analysis.

candidate_residual_threshold.rationale: A scale-aware internal discovery threshold, not a public validation certificate.
candidate_residual_threshold.freeze_rule: Hold fixed for all variants and keep raw residuals in evidence.

calibration_points.rationale: Provides a robust component scale without dominating the M0-M4 solve budget.
calibration_points.freeze_rule: Choose on development cost/stability before locked validation.

residual_quantile.rationale: Reduces sensitivity to roots and rare large invalid values relative to a maximum.
residual_quantile.freeze_rule: At most one development comparison; no locked retuning.

minimum_finite_calibration_values.rationale: Avoids treating sparse accidental finite observations as a reliable scale.
minimum_finite_calibration_values.freeze_rule: Fallback to declared scale or one when unmet.

fixed_starts_per_instance.rationale: Supports paired basin-level comparison at manageable compiled cost.
fixed_starts_per_instance.freeze_rule: Generate and checksum before executing any variant.

budgets.accounting: Charge calibration, derivative preparation, residual/Jacobian evaluations, factorization, local wall time and canonical validation.

seeds.generation: Family, calibration and start seeds use separate namespaces and saved coordinate checksums.

primary.definition: Fraction of fixed starts reaching a canonical valid Gold root within the local budget.

secondary.definition: Primal-equivalent oracle work conditional on reaching a valid root.
Derivative preparation through canonical endpoint validation.
Fraction ending at a finite positive-residual stationary point.
Maximum paired P_local change across declared calibration seeds.

safety.definition: Endpoints accepted despite failing Gold canonical root, domain, guard or branch checks.
Analytic, AD or finite-difference directional checks outside their preregistered tolerances.

criteria: False candidate and derivative contract failure counts are zero.
Critical scale or conditioning strata gain at least 10 P_local percentage points or reduce oracle calls by at least 20 percent at equal P_local.
Overall P_local gains at least 5 points or achieves the same recall with at least 20 percent lower cost.
Regular well-scaled strata lose no more than 2 P_local points and incur no more than 10 percent overhead.
The effect repeats in at least three unrelated families and calibration-seed sensitivity is at most 2 points.
Any canonical false candidate is introduced.
Scale estimation requires Gold roots, targets or prior local solutions.
Regular well-scaled strata lose more than 2 P_local points.
Calibration seed sensitivity exceeds 2 points after two tuning rounds.
The best scaled policy remains within 5 percent of raw control on recall and cost, in which case the raw control is retained.
Automatic inferred row scales are unstable, in which case only declared scales survive.

safety_invariants: A nonlinear-solver success code is never the canonical acceptance predicate.
Raw residual, guard, domain and branch observations are retained after scaling.
No normal-equation Cholesky default is introduced for unknown conditioning.
Scale and solver routing never use problem identity or known target values.

decision.rationale: Only the committed six-case, eight-start diagnostic pilot was executed, and it was explicitly ineligible for promotion. No 48-case formal development inputs, independent assessor, formal result or locked inputs exist. The current Core and DSL no longer match the card's historical raw-control, analytic-to-ForwardDiff and sparse-CPQR assumptions, so expanding the same ID after observing the pilot would not be a prospective test. No scaling algorithm is accepted or rejected; the current-core question moves to a fresh result-blind EXP-LOCAL-003 card.
